verdict.rationale: mParticle documents APIs for sending data in and forwarding it to partner integrations (docs-11, docs-x2) and a Warehouse Sync feature, but the evidence shows Warehouse Sync only ingests data from a customer's warehouse into mParticle (docs-x4), not a comprehensive open-format export/backup of all stored customer data for leaving the platform. No evidence pack item documents a full data-export or account-portability mechanism.
